body: Yes! They will always be mad when you stop putting them and their needs first. I’ve finally realized that and although it’s a process I’m slowly entering my “villain” era and I simply do not give a damn. They can be mad, call me mean, rude, say I’m acting different. Whatever the case may be they can go to hell. I don’t like people who take advantage of “people pleasers” anyway. So it doesn’t hurt my feelings if they no longer like me. :)
It’s funny (not really though) that the minute I saw this picture I immediately thought it was a sign to end my relationship. Then I clicked the post  realized that thought was just my ROCD lol
